# Draft:Map Ranking

----
Map Ranking (Local SEO)
Map Ranking is a term commonly used in Local SEO (Search Engine Optimization) to describe the process of improving a business's visibility within the Google Maps and local search results, especially the "Local 3-Pack" — the top three listings that appear prominently in location-based queries on Google Search.
Overview
Map Ranking is critical for local businesses that rely on attracting customers from specific geographic areas. Unlike traditional SEO, which focuses on improving organic rankings across broad search engine results pages (SERPs), Map Ranking strategies prioritize visibility within the localized section of Google results that includes a map, reviews, and contact information.
Strategies used to improve Map Ranking include:
* Optimizing the Google Business Profile (formerly Google My Business)
* Building citations and local business listings
* Acquiring and managing online reviews
* Proximity and relevance signals
* Embedding location-specific keywords and content
* Backlink building from locally relevant sources
* Consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone Number) data across the web
Importance to Local Businesses
For service-based and storefront businesses — such as plumbers, dentists, restaurants, and cleaning companies — Map Ranking can be a primary source of leads. Appearing in the Local 3-Pack has been shown to increase clicks, calls, and foot traffic significantly.
Companies and Tools Specializing in Map Ranking
Numerous digital marketing agencies and SaaS tools offer services focused specifically on Map Ranking. These include citation management tools, local SEO platforms, and marketing agencies with expertise in Google Maps optimization.
For example, MapRanking.com is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that specializes in helping local service businesses improve their visibility on Google Maps. Their strategies focus on combining Local SEO, Google Ads, and conversion rate optimization to generate qualified leads for businesses in competitive local markets.
